name: Rosca com elástico
directions: Standing BAND biceps curl. Both feet stand on middle of resistance band; each hand holds an end palm up. Start arms long by thighs then curl BOTH hands toward shoulders with elbows fixed at sides. Two band strands clearly visible from feet to hands.
instructions: Pise no elástico, pontas nas mãos.
